required_stages.description: Per (batch, head, query block), in the program that owns it: query tile loaded; running max (-inf or the first visited tile's max), running sum 0 and fp32 output accumulator 0 held on chip.

Single logical pass over the key/value tiles up to the diagonal, each visited once in any order (fully masked tiles not visited): fp32 QK^T, -inf mask on key > query (and overhang), online rescale (alpha = exp(m_old - m_new)) when more than one tile is processed, P rounded to fp16 before the fp32-accumulated PV product.

Final normalisation O / l, rounded to the output dtype and stored; no global intermediate (scores, probabilities, statistics or partial outputs) and no cross-program combine; the launch count is not fixed.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library attention replaces the whole computation
host-side matmul/softmax performs an attention stage
extra buffer; no global scratch or materialised score matrix is permitted (only the output via torch.empty_like)
host-side softmax statistics or mask materialisation
log-sum-exp side output or split-key combine is not part of this operator

required_evidence.message: tile matmul for QK^T and PV
P rounded to fp16 before the PV product

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated tensor with q's shape and dtype on every call

timing_boundary.notes: Measured: GPU time of all device work run() causes (the attention kernel); host scalars, the output allocation call and descriptor metadata are host work, not GPU time. No casts, copies or re-layouts of q/k/v; .contiguous() must be a no-op; no state across calls. flops_expr is the dense count while causal is fixed true (metric review item), bytes_expr is compulsory traffic.
